requirements.value: Applicant must meet qualifications required by Maryland law, have practiced optometry actively for 3 years immediately before applying, have met continuing education requirements of the other state (or equivalent), have been qualified to sit for Maryland's examination at the time of licensure in the other state, have qualified by passing an examination in the other state, present a certified copy of the license, and not have failed a Maryland Board examination within the previous 5 years.
requirements.quote: The Board may grant a waiver under this section only if the applicant: (1) Pays the application fee required by the Board under § 11-303 of this subtitle; (2) Provides adequate evidence that the applicant: (i) Meets the qualifications otherwise required by this title, including, for 3 years before applying, the continuing education requirements of the other state in which the applicant has been practicing optometry

To prescribe eyeglasses, lenses, or contact lenses to correct any optical or visual condition in the human eye

value: use any means known in the science of optics or eye care, except surgery
detect, diagnose, manage, and treat any optical or diseased condition in the human eye and adnexa

methods_authorized.quote: "Practice optometry" includes: (i) The administration of pharmaceutical agents; (ii) The removal of superficial foreign bodies from the cornea and conjunctiva; (iii) The diagnosis, treatment, and management of open–angle glaucoma; (iv) The ordering of cultures and bloodwork testing; and (v) The ordering and performing of in–office, noninvasive, nonradiographic imaging.

drug_authority.value: Therapeutically certified optometrists may administer and prescribe topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for prevention, management, or treatment of conditions and diseases of the eye and ocular adnexa, with restrictions; may not prescribe controlled dangerous substances, certain systemic agents, oral antifungal agents, or antimetabolite agents. May give epinephrine for acute anaphylaxis. Diagnostically certified optometrists may administer topical ocular diagnostic pharmaceutical agents for diagnostic purposes only.
drug_authority.quote: a therapeutically certified optometrist may administer and prescribe therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for the prevention, management, or treatment of conditions and diseases of the eye and ocular adnexa.

surgery_prohibited.quote: to use any means known in the science of optics or eye care, except surgery

surgery_definition.value: a procedure using any instruments, including lasers, scalpels, needles, cautery, a cryoprobe, or sutures in which human tissue is cut, burned, vaporized, removed, or otherwise permanently altered by any mechanical means, laser, ionizing radiation, ultrasound, or other means
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means a procedure using any instruments, including lasers, scalpels, needles, cautery, a cryoprobe, or sutures in which human tissue is cut, burned, vaporized, removed, or otherwise permanently altered by any mechanical means, laser, ionizing radiation, ultrasound, or other means.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: The removal of superficial foreign bodies from the cornea and conjunctiva

epilating with forceps an eyelash from the eyelid, adnexa, or lacrimal system
corneal scraping or conjunctival swabs for cultures
noninvasive meibomian gland expression
orthokeratology
nonsurgical light therapies for meibomian gland disease and vision therapy (not corneal collagen cross linking)
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: "Surgery" does not include: ... glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: The diagnosis, treatment, and management of open–angle glaucoma

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: A therapeutically certified optometrist who treats a patient with open–angle glaucoma in accordance with this section shall refer the patient to an ophthalmologist for an examination within 3 months after the initial diagnosis or presentation to the therapeutically certified optometrist unless the intraocular pressure has been reduced 20% or more from the initial pressure.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: an expiration date for the replacement contact lens prescription of not more than 24 months from the time the patient was first examined

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: an optometrist rehabilitation committee evaluates and provides assistance to any optometrist, and any other individual regulated by the Board, in need of treatment and rehabilitation for alcoholism, drug abuse, chemical dependency, or other physical, emotional, or mental condition.
